record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, add one jointly trained residual feed-forward block after the GRU: z=h+W2(GELU(W1(h))), with a 64-unit bottleneck and zero-initialized W2. Apply it identically at every training position and to inference states. This starts from the incumbent representation while allowing nonlinear candidate compatibility. Preserve GRU recurrence, embeddings, history selection, final-position readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer; update predictor construction consistently.

category_rationales.rationale: Add a jointly trained 64-unit residual GELU block after every GRU output across all four datasets. Zero-initialize its output projection to start from the incumbent representation. Preserve embeddings, recurrent backbone, readout, dot-product scoring, loss and optimizer. The existing predictor writer dynamically imports the updated model class, preserving checkpoint consistency.
